summary: Iteration 149: Trading Mode Switch feature (Phase 1) - All tests pass. Backend: 15/15 pytest tests pass, all API endpoints verified. Frontend: Pill visible in navbar, modal works correctly for both PAPER→LIVE (confirm input + hold button) and LIVE→PAPER (quick confirm) flows.
critical_code_review_comments: VERIFIED: Backend pytest - 15/15 tests pass (service + route level)
VERIFIED: GET /api/trading-mode/current returns 200 with {mode, last_switch_at, cooldown_remaining_s, cooldown_total_s}
VERIFIED: POST /api/trading-mode/switch with mode:live (no confirm_text) returns 400 with detail.code='confirm_required' when in paper mode
VERIFIED: POST /api/trading-mode/switch with mode:live + confirm_text:'LIVE' returns 200 with cooldown_remaining_s:30
VERIFIED: Immediate switch after flip returns 429 with detail.code='cooldown'
VERIFIED: POST /api/trading-mode/switch with mode:futures returns 400 with detail.code='invalid_mode'
VERIFIED: Frontend - Trading mode pill visible in navbar with data-testid='trading-mode-pill' and data-mode attribute
VERIFIED: Frontend - Pill shows 'paper' (mint/cyan) or 'live' (orange) styling based on mode
VERIFIED: Frontend - Modal opens with data-testid='trading-mode-modal'
VERIFIED: Frontend - PAPER→LIVE modal shows confirm input (data-testid='trading-mode-confirm-input'), hold button (data-testid='trading-mode-hold-confirm'), and real money warning
VERIFIED: Frontend - Hold button disabled until 'LIVE' typed, then enabled
VERIFIED: Frontend - LIVE→PAPER modal shows quick-confirm button (data-testid='trading-mode-quick-confirm') with no type-text or hold needed
VERIFIED: Frontend - Close button (data-testid='trading-mode-modal-close') and backdrop click both close modal
VERIFIED: Frontend - Cooldown text appears after successful flip
context_for_next_testing_agent: Trading Mode Switch Phase 1 complete. All 15 backend tests pass. Frontend pill and modal work correctly. Note: There's an onboarding tour overlay that may block interactions - use 'Skip Tour' to dismiss. The 30s cooldown is enforced between mode switches. Phase 2 (order routing per-mode) is NOT in this PR.

POST /api/trading-mode/switch (live, no.description: Returns confirm_required when switching to live without confirm_text

POST /api/trading-mode/switch (live, wit.description: Switches to live mode with 30s cooldown

POST /api/trading-mode/switch (paper).description: Switches to paper mode (no confirm needed)

POST /api/trading-mode/switch (cooldown).description: Returns cooldown error when switching too quickly

POST /api/trading-mode/switch (invalid m.description: Returns invalid_mode for futures/other invalid modes
